name: df-aztec-kit
description: Fee Juice L1→L2 bridge monorepo (core, CLI, API, web)

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r run build
scripts.compile:private-chat: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.aztec/bin:$HOME/.aztec/current/bin:$PATH" && cd contracts/aztec/private_chat && aztec compile && aztec codegen target -o ../../../packages/browser-sdk/src/generated && cp target/private_chat_contract-PrivateChat.json ../../../packages/browser-sdk/src/generated/PrivateChat.json'
scripts.compile:whitelisted-fpc: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.aztec/bin:$HOME/.aztec/current/bin:$PATH" && cd contracts/aztec/whitelisted_fpc && aztec compile && aztec codegen target -o ../../../packages/browser-sdk/src/generated && cp target/whitelisted_fpc_contract-WhitelistedFPC.json ../../../packages/browser-sdk/src/generated/WhitelistedFPC.json'
